text:
pagerduty-bot: HIGH - TLS handshake error spike detected on prod-gateway (us-west-2). 5xx rate up 18% over baseline, error signature: TLS alert handshake_failure. Impacting: customer-facing inference API and some internal health checks. Paging on-call katie.

katie: ack, I'm on it. Looking at SRE dashboard now.

mina: I'm seeing a sudden jump in 526/502 backend errors at the gateway layer, traces show TLS handshake failures when upstream connects to internal model pool (mTLS).

arjun: grabbing cert-rotator logs. kubectl -n infra logs cert-rotator-0 --since=10m shows repeated decrypt errors from KMS before rotation step.

arjun: log snippet:
```
2025-07-15T14:02:11Z ERROR cert-rotator rotation failed: kms.DecryptAccessDenied: access denied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:...
2025-07-15T14:02:11Z ERROR failed to write secret to ssm: AccessDeniedException
```

katie: that could explain private key not being installed -> clients present old cert, server expects new mTLS policy? or vice versa.

lucas: TLS client handshake from gateway -> model-pool fails because gateway can't load the new client cert (private key missing). Upstream returns handshake_failure. So gateway responds 502.

mina: quick check: openssl s_client -connect model-pool-1.internal:443 -cert /etc/gateway/certs/client.pem -key /etc/gateway/certs/client.key -msg

Output shows: "SSL routines:tls_construct_client_key_exchange:unsafe legacy RSA?" but main error is no key (PEM read failed) when using the new path.

deploy-bot: rollback triggered: deployment/prod-gateway updated: image tag r2025.07.14 -> r2025.07.13 (rolling restart).

katie: I'm going to disable automatic cert-rotation job to stop churn while we triage. Mina, lucas — can you patch gateway to use previous certs from backup store?

mina: yes. Found backup artifact in s3://redwood-prod-secrets/cert-backups/2025-07-14/. Pulling and applying to gateway nodes now.

arjun: checked KMS policy change events — looks like an IAM change landed in infra account at 2025-07-15T13:59:30 that removed a cross-account decrypt role used by cert-rotator. Someone pushed a least-privilege change in infra-iam.

katie: timeline: 13:59 IAM change, 14:02 cert-rotator tried to rotate and failed -> 14:03 handshake errors spike. Customer impact window ~14:03-14:30 local. Current mitigation: rolled gateway back and restored previous certs, disabled automatic rotations. Need to confirm traffic normalized.

lucas: metrics: 14:05 error rate dropped from +18% to +3% after rollback, p95 latency back to baseline. Some customers still report intermittent 502s, likely due to cached routes to nodes that hadn't restarted.

mina: quick patch: increased gateway retry to 3 and enabled connection draining for old nodes to let in-flight requests complete.

product-ops: ETA to full remediation? any customers in enterprise tier we should notify?

katie: notifying affected enterprise customers now via status page and direct notices for top 5 tenants. Adding incident severity P2 for now (degraded for some customers).

arjun: for longer-term fix: we'll revert the infra IAM change or update cert-rotator to use a different decrypt role with explicit KMS grants. I'll open a PR to roll back the IAM policy and add a safer test before rotation.

eng-sre-bot: action created: INC-2025-07-15-001 - Revert IAM change / ensure KMS grants. Assigned to arjun. Due 2025-07-16T18:00:00Z.

mina: adding postmortem draft to /incidents/INC-2025-07-15-001, will include timeline, root cause (cert rotation failed due to KMS decrypt denied after IAM change), mitigation (rollback + restore certs), and follow-ups (hardening cert-rotator RBAC and preflight decrypt test).

katie: next: perform controlled cert-rotation dry-run in staging with current IAM policy, and add a canary step that verifies private key write before rolling to prod. Also add alerting for cert-rotator KMS errors as high-priority.

lucas: Confirmed: all prod gateway nodes showing healthy certs and mTLS handshakes passing at 14:28. No new decrypt errors in cert-rotator logs after IAM rollback (manual revert in progress).

product-ops: status update for customers: Creating statuspage incident and mails for top customers. ETA for communication 14:40.

katie: handing off to arjun for postmortem and IAM rollback completion — I'm going offline for on-call overlap in 10m. arjun, can you pick up? @arjun

arjun: taking it. I'll finish the IAM revert, run a staged rotation in prod-safe window, and verify with automated decrypt check. I'll update thread when done.

pagerduty-bot: @arjun acknowledged the page. Escalation timer stopped.

mina: note for postmortem: add runbook step to check KMS decrypt results before enabling rotate job. Also add automated smoke test that does sample mTLS handshake to one model node after rotation.

lucas: tagging this for infra-iam review and security to approve the safe revert.

arjun: update: IAM revert completed at 14:50; ran cert-rotator dry-run against subset (canary) and decrypt succeeded. Will schedule full rotation with canary and preflight checks tomorrow at 02:00 UTC.

katie: thanks team. Closing page for now, leaving incident open until postmortem published.

eng-sre-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem link: /incidents/INC-2025-07-15-001/postmortem-draft.md

product-ops: noted. Will send customer comms (apology + summary + mitigation steps) once postmortem is finalized.

arjun: final note: root cause summary to include: aggressive IAM least-privilege change removed KMS decrypt grant used by cert-rotator, rotation job attempted to write new private key but failed -> gateway nodes ended up with inconsistent cert state -> mTLS handshake failures -> increased 5xx. Remediation: revert IAM change, add preflight decrypt check, add S3 backup fallback + alerting.

katie: thread will be used to collect postmortem edits. If no objections, I'll mark incident resolved in 24h after postmortem published. :white_check_mark:"
